thought: This is a close-up shot of Ge Zhenlin showing his determination and acknowledgment. Since is_continue is true, this follows the previous scene narratively. The shot requires strong side lighting creating chiaroscuro as specified in panel description. I'll generate 2 keyframes: (1) Initial close-up establishing the serious expression with dramatic lighting, using Ref type with character_2 for consistency; (2) The nodding action using Modify type to animate from the first keyframe. keyframe_prompt.sketch_prompt: Simple line art sketch. Close-up shot of a Chinese military man's face and upper shoulders, centered composition. Man in his late twenties facing forward, head upright in neutral position, serious stern expression with tightly pressed lips, intense focused gaze looking straight ahead. Upper chest and uniform collar visible at bottom of frame. Simple dark atmospheric background.
keyframe_prompt.remix_prompt:
Ge Zhenlin (face centered, filling frame): Apply all facial features, physical build characteristics, and uniform details from character_2 reference image.

**Facial Expression & Details:** Hard angular facial lines with prominent strong jawline, tightly pressed lips conveying unyielding determination, intense focused gaze with eyes looking directly forward or slightly past camera, subtle furrow in brow showing concentration and resolve, stern serious expression radiating calm decisiveness and inner strength. Weathered skin texture suggesting outdoor battlefield conditions, slight tension in facial muscles.

**Lighting:** Dramatic chiaroscuro lighting from the left side at approximately 45-degree angle, creating stark high-contrast division across face and neck. Left side of face brightly illuminated revealing detailed contours—cheekbone, brow ridge, nose bridge, jaw line. Right side falling into deep dramatic shadow. Hard-edged shadow line dividing light and dark areas. Strong shadows cast under brow ridge, nose, and lower lip. Subtle rim light on right edge separating silhouette from background.

**Visual Style & Rendering:** Realistic thick-painted 2D animation style with visible impasto brush stroke textures, especially prominent in highlights and shadow transitions. Strong painterly quality with layered paint appearance. Subtle film grain texture overlay for historical documentary atmosphere.

**Color Palette:** Heavily desaturated earthy tones—skin in lit areas shows warm ochre, raw sienna, and muted terracotta; shadows use deep umber, burnt sienna, and dark olive-brown. Visible faded grayish-blue Eight Route Army uniform collar at frame bottom with olive undertones, fabric showing wear texture. Background: deep dark gradient of olive-brown and dark umber, atmospheric without detail.

**Atmosphere:** Solemn, grave, epic mood emphasizing historical weight and martial determination. Strong dramatic tension conveying the serious nature of wartime decisions and sacrifice.

keyframe_prompt.modify_prompt:
Animate a slow, deliberate nod of solemn acknowledgment. Tilt the head downward 15-20 degrees, chin moving closer to chest. Face now angled downward, eyes following the head movement to look down-forward instead of straight ahead, conveying respectful acknowledgment of orders. Eyelids slightly more lowered but eyes still visible and alert, maintaining determined gaze.

Preserve the exact same serious expression—tightly pressed lips, hard angular features, resolute demeanor unchanged. The nod conveys solemn acceptance and determination, not submission.

Adjust lighting and shadows naturally following the new head angle: stronger shadow under brow ridge as head tilts down, shadow on neck shifts accordingly, light-shadow division line on face adjusts to new angle while maintaining same dramatic chiaroscuro quality from left-side lighting. Lit left side still shows strong highlight, right side remains in deep shadow.

Maintain all visual elements: thick-painted 2D animation style, visible brush strokes, impasto texture, low-saturation earthy color palette (ochre, sienna, umber tones), film grain overlay, same uniform collar at bottom, same dark atmospheric background gradient, same solemn epic mood and historical gravity.
